name: Chat
doc: Chat metadata; mirrors the CQL chats table

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the chat was created (UTC epoch millis)

fields.name: chat_name
fields.doc: Optional display name for the chat

fields.name: participants
fields.doc: Member user_ids (3 or more); mirrors CQL set<uuid>, uniqueness enforced by the application. Each member's SSO identity (authenticator, principal, joined_at) lives on the ChatByUser record, not here.
